claim.scope_statement: For the closure A of {2,3} under ab-1, |A intersect [N]| >= (N/12)^s for N>=2, where 2^(-s)+6^(-s)=1. Also A contains no integer congruent to 1 modulo 3, and exact membership is decidable by finite dynamic programming. Positive density is not proved.
